$comment: What was actually benchmarked: the licence as read from each artifact, a checksum that states what it hashes, and how to obtain the model. The companion file configs/models.json says which model each tier should use and cites where a maintainer read its licence; where both cover the same model they are checked against each other. Generated in part from the artifacts themselves -- see scripts/generate_model_zoo_docs.py and docs/models/zoo.md. Licence fields whose license_source is not 'declared' are read from the artifact and must not be edited by hand.

models.name: Qwen2.5 0.5B Instruct (Q4_K_M)
models.notes: The published llama.cpp results record the weights digest; the Ollama results record the manifest digest, listed here as an alias. Both measured these exact weights.

models.name: MobileNet v2 (opset 12)
models.notes: ONNX carries no licence field, so the licence is declared rather than read from the artifact: it is the terms of the ONNX Model Zoo repository that publishes the file. The checksum is of what that URL serves, verified by download. It is deliberately not presented as the identity of the benchmarked file: the four published onnxruntime and openvino results all record checksum: null, so nothing ties them to this or any other file. Results measured after this entry exists can be tied to it; those four cannot, and that is why the entry is here.
